title: Settings
subtitle: How BSDC looks, what it may tell you, who may see you, and what this device keeps.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.banglaNumeralsNote: Counts and dates in ০১২৩ instead of 0123.
appearance.reduceMotionNote: Removes animation and parallax across the platform.
appearance.reduceTransparencyNote: Solid surfaces instead of blurred glass, which also helps low-end devices.
appearance.largeTargetsNote: Every tap target grows to at least 56 pixels.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose what reaches you, and where. Moderation decisions and account security always arrive.
notifications.quietNote: Hold push notifications overnight. Urgent moderation and security notices still arrive.
notifications.quietLater: Quiet hours are set and waiting

source.remote: Saved to your account, on every device you sign in to.
source.local: Saved on this device. The account copy will update when the network returns.
source.default: Defaults. Change anything and it is saved to your account.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Who may see your profile and the details on it.

visibility.public: Anyone, including visitors who are not signed in

privacy.showEmail: Show my email on my profile
privacy.showEmailNote: Off by default. Your email is never shown in search results either way.
privacy.showRegionNote: Shows your division, not your district or anything more precise.
privacy.showLastSeen: Show when I was last active
privacy.showLastSeenNote: Presence is rounded to the nearest five minutes.

data.title: Data and storage
data.subtitle: BSDC keeps a copy of your own content on this device so the platform works with no signal.
data.empty: This device is holding nothing yet. It will fill as you use the platform.
data.exportNote: The content this device holds, in JSON. It is your copy of your own words.
data.clearBody: This empties the offline copy on this device only. Your account on the server is untouched, and the app will refill as you use it. Type BSDC to confirm.

account.title: Account
account.closingNote: Closing your account is not a button yet: until the scheduled job ships, write to {{email}} and a person will do it with you.
